submission.justification: Absorber-F2 at 4mm plate thickness achieves the best possible energy resolution of 3.207% at 100 GeV, representing a 36% improvement over Absorber-F1 (5.043%) and a 19% improvement over Absorber-F3 (3.96%). A comprehensive thickness optimization study scanning from 2-10mm identified 4mm as the optimal thickness, providing the best balance between shower sampling and minimizing lateral spread. All project documents were reviewed and no activation or radiation safety concerns were found that would prevent hands-on maintenance with this material. This configuration delivers state-of-the-art performance while satisfying all operational constraints.
